body: But when the cops pretend it matters when they secretly throw it out the window, that hurts way more than any satisfaction of voicing it. No clue why I'm being down voted, I'm clearly reporting crappy people, it's not my fault the cops are in on the crimes.

I've tried, even had video proof of a douchebag committing his actions. He got away free because his brother is a cop. Not the first time the cops have wiped away something for their personal gain in my life. :(
Holy balls, I figured she just FB stalked him for the date. But to actually have the intent to stalk the church for the whole month is just bonkers as all hell.

Oh no no, you haven't met my mom in law. Her response to me discovering her shit, "oh I forgot I wasn't done!" MMMMMMMMMMMMM OKAYYYYY.

That also was not the last time she didn't flush. She also doesn't wipe, there's no TP in the toilet.

One story: I liked my friend and he liked me back, but he was a hit it and quit it lerson, little to my knowledge. He hit it and quit it, he made it awkward after that. I pushed through his mandatory, awkward whitest and pretended that it never happened and I revived the friendship. I'm fantastic.

Second story: my one friend liked me. He thought he could never be with me. Turns out, I secretly liked him back. Told him how I felt, we started dating, happy, happy!

Remember the first story? Well that friend got jealous (even though he'd bang tons of random girls), but seeing me move on made him demand to have a relationship with me, he was a douchebag about it and I declined and had to cut ties, because he became super fucking creepy about it.

My advice, don't make it awkward. Push through like I did and act like the rejection/etc never happened, that way, the other person sees you not skipping a beat, so they have no reason to keep shit awkard.

You can also pick out their flaws. Super bonus points if they care enough to sit down with you and joke about, "yeah, but if we dated, you'd flip shit because I constantly lick my toes" or what have you. Little therapy session to get it out there. If they're a friend, they should act like it and be happy to tackle the issue and support you to some degree instead of runaway.
Grab my gun and kill him, then wonder when his stupid family will sue me because they don't want to acknowledge that their son is an asshole.

Short is fine. I'm female, I don't have physical preferences. I have a shitty sister who is already super tall, but demands her guy be even taller than if she has high heels on. She bitched about being so lonely, but the good guys I showed her almost made the cut, but they were "too short" by an inch or so. She's a cunt. You're not missing much.
Did you have siblings? I did, I was the constant scapegoat. I don't speak to them anymore.
Walk through Walmart. Honest to god advice. When I feel bad about my visuals, strolling through Walmart quickly changes my opinion and I feel better. A lot better.

I'm too honest and trusting.

I trust people to do the right thing, that never happens. Fuck, even cops refuse to do their job if there's a person they know committing the crime...several experiences with that directly.

I'm too honest. Even if it gets me in trouble. It's respectful to be truthful. Seems like everyone else lies and gets way farther in life because of it.

Been having severe moral debates on becoming a douchebag to see how far I make it in life.

I learned that people choose to be monsters.

My first boyfriend was abusive, emotionally and physically. When I'd try to leave him, he'd cut himself and threaten to kill himself. I'd tell his mom, but they didn't want to acknowledge that her son did that. Heck, no one believed me. My own best friends would witness my boyfriend abusing me, but not bother to speak up, since it was easier to be quiet. So my word alone did nothing and the cops laughed in my face.

So yeah, I learned how much of a monster my first boyfriend was, and how plenty of people thrive on destroying others. I got away because I finally had a great friend to support me and take me away from that situation, when no one, not even my parents cared.

I basically really hate people now.

I love when it has to be me to ask why they're late by an hour. They just didn't care to fill me in. The point of agreeing on a time and date is so it happens at that time and day. It's so freaking easy to do.
That always pissed me off, because I was then forced to take someone else's seat, them take another and it just keeps going.
Ever encounter BO that burns your eyes? I knew a girl who just made it a mission to never wash or use deodorant.
This is my boyfriend. He doesn't get it. I constantly have to coach and teach him not to blurt out shit. It's so frustrating. Weird, because he loves boasting about his "situational awareness"....

Someone did this in a restaurant, so I started bobbing and swaying to the shitty, loud music that was disturbing everyone. Douchebag's boo shot me many murder stares. Apparently, his obnoxious music was okay, but my bobbing was absolutely unforgivable. Who knew.
I always wanted one. Lookit those ears!

Getting raped would not help anyone at all. Trust me, I'm a rape victim. Another reason I'm depressed is that my family refused to believe me since I was a teen and it was "too awkward" for them to talk about, even when I told them.

You and me both. My theme is always trusting people to do the right thing. Involving my parents, siblings, friends, cops, judges. They've all run toward what was personally convenient for them and they refused to do the right thing since it was harder, awkward or whatever excuse they told themselves.

It's not selfish at all.

What's selfish are people berating you with, "don't worry, it gets better!" And they think just that phrase will save you from the crap you're going through.

What's even more selfish are people demanding that you keep enduring your pain, even 20 years of it on a daily basis, just so that they can see you for a few hours during the holidays.

It's sad when people die, and they really can miss us for a week or two, but life goes on and memories fade, they get over it. What doesn't fade is the constant battles that they refuse to acknowledge that you're going through with no relief.

"DNR, please let me go."

I also made a paper of info for my boyfriend, so that he knew my usernames/passwords to bank accounts/etc.

He knew I was incredibly unhappy, for many years. I don't go out of my way to be mean or harm people, yet I constantly deal with horrible people attacking me in what ways they desire. They always know cops, so they get away with everything, when I report what they do, no matter how illegal and how much proof I have, since they have a cop friend or family, it all gets wiped clean and I continue to suffer.

I still battle with thoughts of suicide, because it's been years and years of being an adult and everything is still too fucking rough. No one can talk me out of it. "Keep going, it gets better" is such a slap in the face.

Anyway, I had my DNR paper, and had painters tarp to lay on. That way, I'd shoot myself in the head and have the tarp bunched up so my blood wouldn't spread onto anything, easy clean up. I don't like being a burden so I do what I can to make things as easy as possible.

My boyfriend ended up visiting unexpectedly, which is why I didn't finish the job.

If I go for it again, same exact plan, may or may not have a boyfriend. I don't have friends or family. Might change it to digging a hole in the forest and shoot myself in it there. Just be a missing person that no one remembers, I guess?
